newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia hoists Helsinki to all-time high close.
newsitem.headline: Nokia hoists Helsinki to all-time high close.

text.p: * A Nokia-led spurt lifts shares to all-time highs on the FOX and HEX indices with volume piling up in the last few hours of trade. Forestries up in brisk demand, brokers say. Mixed bag of interim results included some disapointments, they say.
* Volume 835 million markka, 62 pct in Nokia
Shares ended at all-time highs on the main indices, as telecom bluechip Nokia racked up gains on a reaffirmed "buy" recommendation from U.S. investment house Merrill Lynch, brokers said.

The FOX stock futures index gained 0.7 percent to end at a life-high 1,081.12, scraping past its previous May 27 peak by just a point. The all-share HEX index rose 1.07 percent to a life-high 3,142.92 points, topping its previous record by almost 20 points.
"This looks very positive," one broker said after Nokia tilted upwards and Wall Street stocks opened higher.
Nokia advanced 11.50 markka to close at a new life-high 363.50, after touching 364.00 in lively trade, with volume in both the A and K-series shares mounting to 520 million markka.

Nokia was boosted by a reaffirmed "buy" recommendation from U.S. investment house Merrill Lynch, brokers said. A similar Merrill buy recommendation for Nokia's Swedish rival Ericsson sent that share higher on the Stockholm bourse.
